lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhiaagat eh na aakheeahi jin kai man mahi bharam ||
lines.translation: Do not call the wandering beggars holy men, if their minds are filled with doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tin ke dite naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever gives to them, O Nanak, earns the same sort of merit. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੀਖਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhai nira(n)jan param pad taa kaa bheekhak hoi ||
lines.translation: One who begs for the supreme status of the Fearless and Immaculate Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||2||
lines.translation: - how rare are those who have the opportunity, O Nanak, to give food to such a person. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovaa pa(n)dit jotakee ved paRaa mukh chaar ||
lines.translation: If I were a religious scholar, an astrologer, or one who could recite the four Vedas,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਆ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਜ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: navaa kha(n)daa vich jaaneeaa apane chaj veechaar ||3||
lines.translation: I could be famous throughout the nine regions of the earth, for my wisdom and thoughtful contemplation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਕੈਲੀ ਘਾਤੁ ਕੰਞਕਾ ਅਣਚਾਰੀ ਕਾ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahaman kailee ghaat ka(n)njakaa anachaaree kaa dhaan ||
lines.translation: The four Hindu cardinal sins of murdering a Brahmin, a cow, a female infant, and acceptance of the offerings of an evil person,

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਟਕ ਫਿਟਕਾ ਕੋੜੁ ਬਦੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phitak phitakaa koR badeeaa sadaa sadaa abhimaan ||
lines.translation: cursed by the world and diseased by leprosy; he is forever and ever filled with egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਿ ਏਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਵੀਸਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paahi ete jaahi veesar naanakaa ik naam ||
lines.translation: One who forgets the Naam, O Nanak, is covered by these sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬੁਧੀ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh budhee jaaleeahi ik rahai tat giaan ||4||
lines.translation: Let all wisdom be burnt away, except for the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maathai jo dhur likhiaa s met na sakai koi ||
lines.translation: No one can erase that primal destiny written upon one's forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo likhiaa so varatadaa so boojhai jis no nadar hoi ||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whatever is written there, comes to pass. He alone understands, who is blessed by God's Grace. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa kooRai laalach lag ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and become attached to greed and fraud,

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa maaiaa mohanee a(n)tar tisanaa ag ||
lines.translation: are engrossed in the entanglements of Maya the enticer, with the fire of desire within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵੇਲਿ ਨ ਤੂੰਬੜੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਠਗੇ ਠਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa vel na too(n)baRee maaiaa thage thag ||
lines.translation: Those who, like the pumpkin vine, are too stubborn climb the trellis, are cheated by Maya the cheater.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਚਲਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਮਿਲਹੀ ਵਗਿ ਸਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ba(n)nhi chalaaeeahi naa milahee vag sag ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged and led away; the dogs do not join the herd of cows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaae bhuleeai aape mel milaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself misleads the misguided ones, and He Himself unites them in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh chhuteeai je chalai satigur bhaai ||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saalaahee saalaahanaa bhee sachaa saalaahi ||
lines.translation: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, and sing the Praises of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਆਹਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa ek dar beebhaa parahar aahi ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is True; stay away from all other doors. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jah jah mai phirau tah tah saachaa soi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, wherever I go, I find the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah ek hai guramukh paragat hoi ||8||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh visaaran sabad hai je ma(n)n vasaae koi ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is the Dispeller of sorrow, if one enshrines it in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕਰਮ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te man vasai karam paraapat hoi ||9||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, it dwells in the mind; by God's Mercy, it is obtained. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hau hau karate khap mue khoohan lakh asa(n)kh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, acting in egotism, countless thousands have wasted away to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਲੰਖ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mile s ubare saachai sabad ala(n)kh ||10||
lines.translation: Those who meet with the True Guru are saved, through the Shabad, the True Word of the Inscrutable Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa satigur ik man seviaa tin jan laagau paai ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru single-mindedly - I fall at the feet of those humble beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee har man vasai maaiaa kee bhukh jaai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord abides in the mind, and the hunger for Maya departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan niramal oojale j guramukh naam samaai ||
lines.translation: Immaculate and pure are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, merge in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਰਿ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hor patisaaheeaa kooReeaa naam rate paatisaah ||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, other empires are false; they alone are true emperors, who are imbued with the Naam. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਘਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਲੋਚੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu purakhai ghar bhagatee naar hai at lochai bhagatee bhaai ||
lines.translation: The devoted wife in her husband's home has a great longing to perform loving devotional service to him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰਸ ਸਾਲਣੇ ਸਵਾਰਦੀ ਖਟ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu ras saalane savaaradee khat ras meethe paai ||
lines.translation: she prepares and offers to him all sorts of sweet delicacies and dishes of all flavors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiu baanee bhagat salaahade har naamai chit laai ||
lines.translation: In the same way, the devotees praise the Word of the Guru's Bani, and focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan dhan aagai raakhiaa sir vechiaa gur aagai jaai ||
lines.translation: They place mind, body and wealth in offering before the Guru, and sell their heads to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਗਤ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bhagatee bhagat bahu lochade prabh lochaa poor milaai ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God, His devotees yearn for His devotional worship; God fulfills their desires, and merges them with Himself.
